papers.title: Defect detection in selective laser melting technology by acoustic signals with deep belief networks
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Automation, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, 230026, China

corresponding_authors.name: Dongsen Ye
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Automation, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, 230026, China

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文涉及SLM过程监控，但完全不涉及生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、多孔结构、疲劳或表面特性。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on defect detection via acoustic signals in SLM, with no mention of porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用声学信号和深度学习检测SLM中的缺陷。
summary_zh.method: 采用深度信念网络对声学信号进行分类。
summary_zh.result: 该方法能有效识别SLM过程中的缺陷。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验数据验证了缺陷检测的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to detect defects during selective laser melting using acoustic signals and deep learning.
summary_en.method: A deep belief network is employed to classify acoustic signals from the SLM process.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves effective defect detection in SLM.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on experimental acoustic data from SLM builds.

papers.title: Study of Selective Laser Melting of intermetallic TiAl powder using integral analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Lyon University, ENISE, LTDS Laboratory, UMR CNRS 5513, 58 rue Jean Parot, 42023, Saint-Étienne Cedex 2, France

corresponding_authors.name: I. Smurov
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Lyon University, ENISE, LTDS Laboratory, UMR CNRS 5513, 58 rue Jean Parot, 42023, Saint-Étienne Cedex 2, France

papers.venue: International Journal of Machine Tools and Manufacture

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究TiAl金属间化合物的选区激光熔化，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TiAl金属间化合物的SLM工艺可行性
summary_zh.method: 采用积分分析方法优化SLM工艺参数
summary_zh.result: 获得了TiAl粉末的SLM成形工艺窗口
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论分析与实验对比验证工艺参数

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of selective laser melting (SLM) for intermetallic TiAl powder.
summary_en.method: An integral analysis method is employed to optimize SLM process parameters.
summary_en.result: The processing window for SLM of TiAl powder is established.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis and limited experimental comparison validate the process parameters.

papers.title: Experimental comparison of the flow rate and cooling performance of internal cooling channels fabricated via selective laser melting and conventional drilling process
papers.first_author_affiliation: Additive Manufacturing Institute, College of Mechatronic and Control Engineering, Shenzhen University, Shenzhen, 518060, China

corresponding_authors.name: Changyong Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Additive Manufacturing Institute, College of Mechatronic and Control Engineering, Shenzhen University, Shenzhen, 518060, China

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及冷却通道的流动和冷却性能，与用户的研究方向（骨科植入物、生物打印、有限元代理模型等）无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, osseointegration, porous structures, or any biomechanical context relevant to AM biomedical materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较选区激光熔化与传统钻孔制造的冷却通道性能差异。
summary_zh.method: 实验测量并对比两种工艺制造的冷却通道的流量和冷却性能。
summary_zh.result: SLM制造的通道在冷却性能上优于钻孔通道。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量流量和温度验证。

summary_en.motivation: To experimentally compare the flow rate and cooling performance of internal cooling channels fabricated by selective laser melting versus conventional drilling.
summary_en.method: Flow rate and cooling performance were measured and compared for channels made by SLM and drilling.
summary_en.result: SLM-fabricated channels exhibited superior cooling performance compared to drilled ones.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of flow rate and temperature distribution were used for validation.
